def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    line=next(i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg)
    lc=grid[line][0]
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,lc)]
    if not cells: return [r[:] for r in grid]
    minr=min(i for i,j,v in cells); maxr=max(i for i,j,v in cells)
    minc=min(j for i,j,v in cells); maxc=max(j for i,j,v in cells)
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out[line]=[lc]*w
    dr=line+1-minr
    for i,j,v in cells:
        if 0<=i+dr<h: out[i+dr][j]=v
    marker=line+1+(maxr-minr+1)
    if marker<h: out[marker]=[8]*w
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max({v for row in grid for v in row},key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    bar=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg)
    bc=grid[bar][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,bc)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts);r1=max(r for r,c in pts);c0=min(c for r,c in pts);c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    obj=[grid[r][c0:c1+1] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)];out[bar]=[bc]*w
    if r1<bar:
        dest=bar-len(obj)
        for k,row in enumerate(obj):out[dest+k][c0:c1+1]=row
        if dest>0:out[dest-1]=[8]*w
    else:
        dest=bar+1
        for k,row in enumerate(obj):out[dest+k][c0:c1+1]=row
        if dest+len(obj)<h:out[dest+len(obj)]=[8]*w
    return out
